text:
sylvia: weird WFH morning alert : i was on a standup and the whole house internet flaked. thought it was ISP but turns out my treadmill kicked on and the router rebooted. apparently the treadmill motor pulls a lot of current and the outlet is on the same circuit as the network closet. :running_woman: :zap:
marc: omg thats wild. did the breaker trip or just a brownout?
sylvia: no full trip, just a sag. router LEDs blinked, then APs came back one by one. ping looked messy for a few minutes. pasted quick ping to 8.8.8.8 i ran right after:
```
PING 8.8.8.8 (8.8.8.8): 56 data bytes
64 bytes from 8.8.8.8: icmp_seq=1 ttl=118 time=32.0 ms
64 bytes from 8.8.8.8: icmp_seq=2 ttl=118 time=28.7 ms
Request timeout for icmp_seq 3
64 bytes from 8.8.8.8: icmp_seq=4 ttl=118 time=120.5 ms
64 bytes from 8.8.8.8: icmp_seq=5 ttl=118 time=30.2 ms
--- 8.8.8.8 ping statistics ---
5 packets transmitted, 4 packets received, 20.0% packet loss
rtt min/avg/max = 28.7/46.9/120.5 ms
```
dana: treadmill brownouts = new category of WFH hazard. :laughing: can you move router to a different circuit or plug treadmill somewhere else?
sylvia: unplugging treadmill for meetings is my short-term fix. long-term: electrician to move the outlet or add dedicated circuit for heavy appliances. also ordered a small UPS for the network closet so brief sags won't kill the router.
leo: good moves. UPS is clutch. also, a cheap trick: put the modem+router on the UPS but leave high-draw gear (treadmill/AC) on a different surge strip on another circuit. avoids overload on the UPS.
sylvia: thanks. learned the hard way that cardio can DDOS your home network. :sweat_smile: will label the treadmill outlet "NOT during standups"
marc: pro tip: schedule treadmill sprints for outside meeting hours.
ops-bot: note: company resource reminder  we can ship a loaner hotspot or a compact travel router for short-term outages. open a request in #help with subject "loaner hotspot". include "urgent" if you have back-to-back meetings.
dana: also suggests: run a 10 minute continuous ping while you do a treadmill test to capture the pattern for electrician/ISP if needed. timestamps help.
sylvia: will do a test tonight and report back. appreciate the quick tips and the sympathy for modern-home cardio chaos. :raised_hands:
